eras.label: c. 2000 BCE · Late Archaic summer camps
eras.text: Excavations document Late Archaic summer camps on this Ohio River terrace around 2000 BCE (Cave Run, Merom and Rowlette points). Dot is a rounded, approximate location.

eras.label: c. 2000 BCE–300 CE · no dated occupation in the cited source
eras.text: The cited source gives no dated occupation between the Late Archaic camps and the Middle–Late Woodland communities, so no dot is shown.

eras.label: 300–600 CE · Middle–Late Woodland communities
eras.text: Denser Middle–Late Woodland communities (about 300–600 CE) with circular post structures, tool workshops and storage. Fort Ancient people used the terrace later; the source gives no date for that use, so it is not on the slider.

sources.label: The Archaeology of Kentucky: An Update, Archaic Period chapter (Kentucky Heritage Council)
